result:
I’d make it harder for minds to reduce other people into categories.

Not to make everyone agree, not to fix institutions first—but to remove the mental shortcut that lets someone see a person as a threat, a stereotype, a resource, a nuisance, or background noise. If every person still registered, in ordinary moments, as a full subject rather than an object, the world would become less cruel, less exploitative, and less stupid.

Disagreement could remain. Conflict could remain. But the easiest engine of dehumanization would be missing.
